alignments.note: Imperative; unit discontinuous from the fronted vocative under rule 25.
Vocative substantive takes the supplied *O ye* into its own unit under rule 36, headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
Vocative substantival adjective with its supplied *ye* under rule 36.
The second imperative is recast as *be of an understanding*; the copular *be* and its connective *of* belong to that rendering, headed on the word carrying the verb's lexeme.

Noun with the supplied indefinite article, which determines the nominal expression and joins the noun's unit under rule 15; discontinuous under rule 25. A competing reading would put *an* with *understanding*, but rule 15 places a supplied determiner on the noun of the expression.
